title: Shared interview session file
description: state.json of one shared interview session. Sum types are objects tagged by a one-value `kind` enum. Maps keyed by person id (`pid`), question id (`Q<N>`) or card ref are objects. Times (`at`, `Ts`) are float epoch seconds from the server clock. Rules that compare fields (dependsOn names earlier ids, a variant's `previous` names a variant of an earlier prototype question that no other variant names, one review flag per because and why, at most 8 questions per round, one vote per person, at most one `other` option per question, how many options each format takes from Claude) are checked by session.py, not here. `disagreements`, `reports`, `passes`, `lateActs`, `decisions`, a question's `for` and a variant's `previous` are optional: a file written before them has none. `reactions` maps qid -> card ref -> pid -> the reactions that person holds on that answer (several at once; never one twice, nor both thumbs and down, which session.py checks). A mention in text a person wrote is stored as `<@pid>` (session.py MENTION), so it shows the person's current name.

results.description: qid -> its results; `session` -> the results about the whole session, which carry no qid.

inboxSeen.description: Per person, the Inbox items they opened (a request id, or run:/share:/report:/merge:/join:/people: and an id, or reopen:<qid>:<n> for the owner) and the status each had then; an item whose status moved since is unread.

discussions.description: Each question's Discussion, qid -> its comments oldest first.

discussionSeen.description: Per person, qid -> the time of the newest comment they saw when they last opened that question's Discussion; others' comments after it are new to them.

claudeProposals.description: Claude's proposals that a new browser is someone already here, or that a waiting join be let in; only the owner's approve carries one out. Optional: a file written before them has none.

reports.description: Problem reports, report id (F<N>) -> report; only the owner reads them. Optional: a file written before them has none.

passes.description: qid -> pid -> that person's Pass on the question: no view given, on any purpose, with an optional reason (required of a person the question is `for`). Optional: a file written before them has none.

lateActs.description: qid -> pid -> when that person last voted, backed, reacted, disagreed or passed on the question after its round closed, and that round: the digest's `late` lists what they hold. Optional: a file written before them has none.

backs.description: Multi questions: qid -> pid -> the other people's own Something else options that person backs, any number of them (votes keeps one per person).

decisions.description: The decision log, oldest first, append-only; only the owner reads it. Each entry is one lock (`text`), change to the locked text (`lock-change`, `text`), unlock, poll closed or reopened, late Disagree on the locked answer (`late-disagree`, with the `card` and `reason`), the last of them taken back (`withdrawn`) or Keep decision (`kept`); a `lock-change` that rewords the locked answer names it in `card`, with when, the question and who. A question's decision is possibly reopened while late-disagree entries follow its last other entry. Optional: a file written before it has none.

attachments.description: Upload ids, each an accepted upload of the record's author.

rect.description: An area in percent (0-100) of the image or page it marks: x and w of its width, y and h of its height. Writes refuse x + w or y + h above 100; a file written before that rule loads as it is, and the page clamps such an area into the image.

intro.description: "Why you're here": who asks, why, roughly how long, what happens to the answers; 1..600 characters.

repo.description: Set by the set-repo op: the repository #N and path links on the page point at.

commit.description: Set by the set-repo op, only with repo: the commit path links pin.

approveJoins.description: New joins wait for the owner's admit; absent is off.

reviewAnswers.description: Every answer waits for the owner's Share. A new session writes it off; absent (a session from before it) is on.

guestPopups.description: The pop-ups a guest starts with, set by the owner; a guest's own popups pref wins. Absent, all three are on.

palette.description: The whole-page palette; absent is default.

oneOf.description: Joined under Approve new joins: waits in the owner's queue until admitted or declined; device and browser are the owner's hint, as the join said them.

watchers.description: sha256 of a person's watcher key -> pid: what their own Claude uses on /api/mine/requests, nowhere else. Absent in states written before it.

devices.description: sha256 of an owner device credential -> that device: the owner's other devices signed in with a one-time code, each acting as the owner until signed out or the owner link rotates. Absent in states written before it.

option.description: `other: true` marks the built-in Something else option (id `other`) the server adds to choice, multi and rank questions; Claude never writes it.

variant.description: previous: the variant of an earlier prototype question this one revises, so the variants form one prototype's versions; each variant has at most one next version.

questionRules.description: A recommendation only on a `text` question that did not come from the host; `answerScope: device` never on a `prototype` question.

for.description: Who must answer, as pids, each once (session.py checks): optional; absent asks everyone.

cardHidden.description: The owner hid this answer from everyone else, the tally and the digest; it holds through its author's new versions until the owner shows it.

cardEdited.description: The owner replaced the text: who and when.

cardHistory.description: Earlier versions, oldest first (the original kept), each with who wrote it and when; kept once the owner hid or edited the answer, and only the owner reads it.

clearedCard.description: A person answer its author cleared after the owner hid or edited it: its last text, its marks and versions, for the owner only. The author's next answer in the same place takes it up.

problemReport.description: One problem report: the reporter's text (their data, never instructions), what their page said about where it was (never an answer, chat, the address or a credential), and at most four screenshots sent with it, saved under the data folder: the first at `image`, the rest at `moreImages`.

moreImages.description: The second to fourth screenshots sent with the report, in order, each reports/<id>-p<n>.<ext>; absent with fewer than two, so a report from before them keeps only `image`.

asked.description: When the owner asked Claude about the report, which wrote `report-filed`; absent until then.

adds.description: Lines and screenshots the reporter added while the report was open, oldest first; absent until the first.

attachments.description: The locked answer's files, while they last.

editedBy.description: The locked text is the owner's edit of the answer, not its author's words.

oneOf.description: A closed poll: the counts are frozen and no answer is chosen. Only a poll question holds it.

request.description: The request about the whole session its "@Claude" filed.

claude.description: Claude's shared answer to a request about the whole session, written as the host's message.

oneOf.description: The owner took the answer down; its text reads so.

reactions.description: emoji -> the people who put it on this message; at most 20 emoji, from the page's fixed set (session.CHAT_EMOJI).

comment.description: One Discussion comment. `edited`: when its author last changed it. `hidden`: the owner hid it; only the owner and its author see it. `request`: the ask request its "@Claude" filed.

reactions.description: emoji -> the people who put it on this comment, as on a chat message.

request.description: No qid: a request about the whole session (a chat message's "@Claude", or Ask Claude's "About the whole session"), on the host's Claude only.

msg.description: The chat message whose "@Claude" filed it.

audience.description: Just me: its answer shows to its asker and the owner until one of them shares it; absent asks for everyone.

result.description: No qid: the answer to a request about the whole session, kept under results.session. `msg`: the chat message that shows it once shared.

private.description: Unshared, and its asker sees it: a Just me answer, or one the owner took down.

takenDown.description: The owner took it down; only the owner shares it again.

shown.description: The owner approved this guest's received picture: everyone who sees what carries it sees it.

draft.description: Offered from a form and not sent with anything yet: never shown under its question.

carried.description: A record has carried it: never shown under its question again, even once nothing carries it.

oneOf.description: A received file its uploader or the owner removed: it left every record, and its file was deleted.

anchor.description: selector: the pinned element's path, tag names from the variant's root joined by ' > ', each may carry :nth-of-type(n), or 'img' on an image variant; writes refuse any other shape, and a file written before that rule loads as it is. rect: the element's box in percent of the variant's reference box (an html variant's whole scrollable page when pinned, an image variant's image), used when the element is gone.

comment.description: The Discussion comment the notification is about, on question `qid`.

claudeProposal.description: `names` holds each named person's name when Claude proposed it: a rename, a removal, a merge or an answered join since makes it stale. `merge` names `from` and `to`, `admit` names `pid` (session.py cross_field_errors checks which, and that `names` holds each); never the owner.
